name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.39-beta “Paris” (build 40): buy inside the app, and fixes from the first testers.
• New: Help → Buy a Licence… opens the checkout right inside LitArbi. After the payment LitArbi activates itself, with no key to copy. It is also offered to guests and when a licence has ended. The key also arrives by email, for your second computer.
• Fixed: the licence key can be pasted with Ctrl+V. This also works when the copied text has a line break around it.
• Fixed: OCR finds the PDF of an exhibit even when it was added in the Files tab, and explains when there is nothing to recognise. OCR runs on your PC and needs no API key.
• Backups and the Word exhibit list: when Windows Security's "Controlled folder access" keeps LitArbi out of the Documents folder, LitArbi now says so and explains where to allow it.
• The ribbon colours are the same as on the Mac again.
• Build 38: the Word and Writer add-ins follow every numbering.
